usedFor: Shopify holds new customers and UserCheck checks email addresses, so “New Customer” can run “Verify Email”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Shopify, then “Verify Email” in UserCheck
bestTemplate.why: Each new customer's address is checked for validity, disposable use and spam before you rely on it.

watchOut: “Verify Email” in UserCheck only reports whether an address is valid, so add a step to act on the result.
